# IDSToken
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/securitize/IDSToken.sol)

**Inherits:**
IERC20Metadata

**Title:**
IDSToken

Minimal interface for a Securitize DS Protocol security token (`DSToken`).

The token is a standard ERC20 whose transfers are gated by an off-chain-configured
compliance service: both sender and receiver must be registered investor wallets and the
transfer must satisfy lock-up / pause / jurisdiction rules. `preTransferCheck` lets an
integrator (e.g. this Ark) verify a transfer will pass before attempting it.
Mint (`issueTokens`) and burn are issuer/transfer-agent only and are intentionally NOT
exposed here — subscription and redemption are settled off-chain by Securitize.


## Functions
### preTransferCheck

Dry-runs the compliance checks for a prospective transfer.


```solidity
function preTransferCheck(
    address _from,
    address _to,
    uint256 _value
)
    external
    view
    returns (uint256 code, string memory reason);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_from`|`address`|The prospective sender|
|`_to`|`address`|The prospective receiver|
|`_value`|`uint256`|The transfer amount (in token units)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`code`|`uint256`|0 if the transfer would be permitted, otherwise a non-zero failure code|
|`reason`|`string`|Human-readable reason matching the failure code|


### getDSService

Returns the address of a DS Protocol service by its numeric service id.

Service ids follow the DS Protocol `IDSServiceConsumer` convention — notably
`4 = registry service` and `8 = compliance service`. Lets an integrator resolve the
registry from the token itself rather than passing it (and risking a mismatch).


```solidity
function getDSService(uint256 _serviceId) external view returns (address);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_serviceId`|`uint256`|The DS Protocol service id|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The service contract address (zero if unset)|
